title: The Gold And Silver Trades I Just Took
speaker: Nick Valdez

macro_themes.view: Saudi Arabia-Yemen escalation pushed oil to a two-week high.

calls.reason: Gold near ascending trend line; expects a bounce despite a megaphone pattern that slightly favors downside. Long IAU November options, may add.
calls.quote: I am thinking, you know, we might get a nice little bounce on the gold chart.

calls.condition: Adds near trend line ~57.67; if structure is lost could fall to 54.
calls.reason: Small long in SLV; silver not yet at its ascending trend line so less bullish than gold; wedge pattern.
calls.quote: I'm not as bullish on silver as I am bullish on gold.

calls.reason: Oil pumped ~3% to a two-week high but is trapped in a wedge between July-2026 low support line and March-2026 wick-high resistance line.
calls.quote: the price action for now is trapped within this little bit of a wedge pattern.

calls.condition: If nat gas closes above the descending trend line from March 9, watch the parallel-channel top as resistance to short.
calls.reason: Testing a descending trend line from March; previously went long; would short at channel resistance after a breakout.
calls.quote: This is where I would want to short natural gas, everybody.

calls.reason: Failed to hold breakout level of ascending channel; expects a retest of it as support.
calls.quote: Now we're going to come down and retest this as a level of support on copper.

notes: Gold/silver prices not stated except silver ~59 (units ambiguous: may be SLV not spot). NG short-term 'bullish' reflects prior long and trend-line test; his stated trade is a short at higher resistance. Platinum mentioned as watch only, skipped.
